chunks: He said: "I am afraid of sending him with you lest a wolf should devour him when you are unmindful."

key_terms.يَحْزُنُنِي: makes me sad / causes me grief

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Jacob fear would happen to Joseph when his brothers took him away?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Yaqub) articulates his paternal grief and vigilance, highlighting the tension between his sons' casual departure and his acute awareness of potential danger. Shia scholars often view this moment as a precursor to the broader theme of divine protection amidst human negligence, emphasizing that Jacob's fear was not merely emotional but rooted in his prophetic insight into the trials ahead. The mention of the wolf serves as a literal threat that foreshadows the eventual betrayal, underscoring the fragility of familial bonds under pressure.
